<div class="project-meta"><strong>Status:</strong> Planned · <strong>Type:</strong> Software-paper concept · <strong>Decision gate:</strong> 30 June 2027</div>

## Purpose

This manuscript will be activated only if the underlying `fishcore` R framework matures into a sufficiently general, documented, tested, and reusable scientific software product to justify a dedicated software publication.

## Evidence required before activation

- stable public API and semantic versioning;
- comprehensive documentation and automated tests;
- synthetic or open examples and reproducible vignettes;
- demonstrated reuse across multiple downstream products;
- a defensible gap relative to existing fisheries R packages.

## Current stage

No substantial manuscript development is planned before the decision gate. Development effort should remain focused on software stabilization and demonstrated reuse.

## Candidate output

A software paper, potentially for the *Journal of Open Source Software* or *The R Journal*, only if the publication criteria are met.

::: {.qs-footnote-note}
This is intentionally shown as a planned project rather than as an active publication. A private paper repository can exist as a decision gate without implying that a manuscript is already underway.
:::
